gaps.explanation: Schedule ABOVE statement by 1,683,075. Statement (pp6-7) prints 'Issuance of debt from bonds' Debt Service 12,675,000 + Economic Development 3,080,000 + 84th Street 20,785,000 = 36,540,000 (JSON debt_proceeds) and, on a separate row, 'Premium from bonds' Debt Service 982,391 + 84th Street 700,684 = 1,683,075 (JSON other_financing). The budget-basis schedules print one 'Bond proceeds' line per fund that includes the premium: Debt Service 13,657,391 (p14) = 12,675,000 + 982,391; Economic Development 3,080,000 (p16); 84th Street 21,485,684 (p17) = 20,785,000 + 700,684; total 38,223,075 = 36,540,000 + 1,683,075. The difference is the bond premium, counted in other_financing; tying debt_proceeds alone would mean splitting the printed schedule lines, so they are left as printed. No fix.
